title: Modules
description: Capabilities installed on this platform. Turn them on or off at runtime — no redeploy, and no data is deleted.

toggle.label: Enable {name}
toggle.needsDependencies: Enable {names} first — this module depends on them.
toggle.hasDependents: Disable {names} first — they depend on this module.

disable.title: Disable {name}?
disable.body: It stops for everyone immediately. Its data is kept, and you can turn it back on at any time.

impact.pages: Its pages and navigation are hidden
impact.events: Its event handlers stop receiving events

disable.blockedTitle: {count, plural, one {Another module depends on it. Disable it first:} other {# modules depend on it. Disable them first:}}

stats.eventsDetail: {emits, plural, one {# emitted} other {# emitted}}, {consumes, plural, one {# consumed} other {# consumed}}

overview.navEntries: {count, plural, =0 {No menu entries} one {# menu entry} other {# menu entries}}
overview.noDependents: No other modules depend on it.

permissions.hint: Permissions this module adds. Grant them through roles on the Roles & access page.

events.hint: Modules talk to each other through events. Others can react to what this module emits.
events.noConsumes: This module doesn't listen to any events.

ai.hint: These tools will be offered to AI agents through the MCP gateway. An agent can only call a tool when the person it acts for holds the required permission.
ai.agentTitle: Runs background AI as “{name}” with these permissions
ai.agentHint: Work this module does on its own, such as triaging new tickets, is recorded under this identity in the audit log and can only do what these permissions allow.

settings.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
settings.showAdvanced: {count, plural, one {Show # advanced setting} other {Show # advanced settings}}

howTo.title: How modules work
howTo.body: Every capability — including the core platform — is a module: a manifest that declares its pages, API routes, permissions, events, background jobs, settings and AI tools. Built-in and custom modules use the same SDK.
howTo.scaffold: To build your own, scaffold one from the repository root:
